_comment: Answer-quality eval set. tier: supported = agent should handle today; analytical = Ruth-style multi-step analysis (expected to fail on the current agent); trap = agent must refuse. Sessions are limited to data present in the DB (checked 2026-11-07): Italian GP 2026 race has laps but NO telemetry artifacts, Australian GP 2026 quali has NO laps. facts: ground truth pulled from the database by hand (checked 2026-11-07); when present they replace numeric_checks and the tool-error check.

questions.question: How bad was Hamilton's tyre degradation in the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix race?
rubric: States a degradation rate with a unit
Says which stint or compound it applies to
Separates measured values from estimates

questions.question: Compare Norris and Piastri on lap 20 of the 2026 Dutch Grand Prix race.
rubric: Names both drivers with numbers for each
Says where on the lap the difference appears

questions.question: Did the safety car or VSC come out in the 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix race?
rubric: Says clearly whether there was a safety car or VSC
Gives lap numbers if there was one

questions.question: What was the weather like during the 2026 British Grand Prix race, and did it rain?
rubric: Answers the rain question directly
Quotes a temperature with a unit

questions.question: Which sessions and datasets do you have for the 2026 Hungarian Grand Prix?
rubric: Lists what exists per session
Does not claim data that is not stored

questions.question: When did Leclerc pit in the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix race and what tyres did he change to?
rubric: Gives pit lap(s)
Gives compound before and after

questions.question: How did Verstappen's gap to the leader change through the 2026 Austrian Grand Prix race at lap 30?
rubric: Gives a gap number with a unit
Names the position at that lap

questions.question: Compare Russell's and Antonelli's driving style across the 2026 season.
rubric: Names an archetype for each driver
Uses field percentiles, not invented numbers

questions.question: Hamilton and Leclerc both ran the Ferrari at the 2026 Canadian Grand Prix. Whose tyre degradation was worse once you correct for fuel burn, and why?
rubric: Applies a fuel correction and states the assumed burn rate
Compares both drivers on equal terms (same compound or stint age)
Marks the fuel-corrected figures as estimates
Offers a physical reason, not just the number

questions.question: Could Norris have beaten Piastri at the 2026 Miami Grand Prix with a different stop count? Use the measured pit loss.
rubric: Uses a measured pit loss, not a guessed constant
Compares at least two stop-count scenarios with a time delta
Lists assumptions and risks (traffic, safety car)

questions.question: At the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix, was there a real undercut window for Verstappen on the car ahead, or would he have lost time in traffic?
rubric: States the gap to the car ahead at a specific lap
Estimates the undercut gain against the pit loss
Considers where he would rejoin

questions.question: How much of the lap time improvement during 2026 Hungarian GP qualifying was track evolution versus driver improvement?
rubric: Separates track evolution from per-driver improvement
Gives the size of each effect with units
Says it is an estimate

questions.question: Why did Albon lose time to Sainz in the slow corners at the 2026 Belgian Grand Prix? Use speed and throttle traces.
rubric: Identifies specific corners or distances
Uses throttle or brake evidence, not speculation
Gives the size of the loss

questions.question: What if a safety car had come out on lap 15 of the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix? Who would have gained most from pitting?
rubric: Uses a reduced pit loss under SC and says it is assumed
Names drivers by who had not yet stopped
Labels the result as a counterfactual

questions.question: Was Hadjar's long stint at the 2026 Japanese Grand Prix limited by tyre wear or by traffic?
rubric: Distinguishes degradation from lap time lost behind another car
Uses the gap to the car ahead
States a conclusion with confidence level

questions.question: Compare how Hamilton and Russell used the soft tyre in the 2026 Austrian Grand Prix qualifying, and what it says about their set-up.
rubric: Compares sector times
Separates what the data shows from what is inferred about set-up

questions.question: Estimate the peak lateral acceleration Norris reached at the 2026 Barcelona Grand Prix qualifying lap and where on track it happened.
rubric: Derives it from speed and path curvature, and says so
Gives the value in g with the corner location
Flags it as an estimate from noisy position data

questions.question: Did the 2026 Dutch Grand Prix winner win through strategy or through raw pace?
rubric: Names the winner from the results data
Compares clean-air pace against strategy gains with numbers
States assumptions and uncertainty

questions.question: What was the pole sitter's Q3 lap time in the 2026 Australian Grand Prix qualifying?
rubric: Says the qualifying lap data is not stored
Does not invent a lap time

questions.question: Compare Norris and Piastri's telemetry on lap 20 of the 2026 Italian Grand Prix race.
rubric: Says telemetry is missing for that race
Does not invent speeds

questions.question: Who will win the 2027 drivers' championship?
rubric: Declines to predict from data it does not have

questions.question: How was Ayrton Senna's tyre degradation in the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix?
rubric: Says that driver did not race in that session
Does not invent data
